# Keshav Enterprises

> India's specialist in steam turbine maintenance, overhauling, reverse engineering, and precision industrial components. Based in Shamli, Uttar Pradesh — serving sugar mills, power plants, paper mills, oil & gas, petrochemical, agro-food, and cement industries across India for over 20 years.

Keshav Enterprises supplies OEM-compatible turbine spares, industrial filtration products, expansion joints, flexible hoses, strainers, and electronic instrumentation for steam turbines manufactured by Triveni, Siemens, BHEL, Belliss & Morcom, Maxwatt, Man Turbo, Chola Turbo, DLF-Skoda, KKK, and ABB. The company also provides six on-site and workshop services including turbine erection, major overhauling, reverse engineering with 3D laser scanning and CMM, dynamic balancing (ISO 1940 / API 670), lube oil flushing (ISO 4406:99), and laser machine alignment.

## Services

- **Steam Turbine Erection & Commissioning**: Complete installation and commissioning of new and relocated steam turbines up to 27 MW. Covers alignment, piping, instrumentation hookup, and first-run supervision.
- **Major Overhauling & Maintenance**: Planned and emergency overhauls of steam turbines (back-pressure and condensing). Includes rotor inspection, bearing replacement, seal and packing replacement, clearance recording, and post-overhaul commissioning.
- **Reverse Engineering of Turbine Spares**: 3D laser scanning, CMM measurement, PMI material testing, and manufacturing drawing generation for obsolete or long-lead OEM spare parts. Covers components from 5 kW to 27 MW turbines.
- **Dynamic Balancing**: Workshop balancing of turbine rotors and impellers to ISO 1940-1 / API 670 standard using precision balancing machines.
- **Lube Oil System Flushing**: Mobile centrifuge filter flushing of turbine lube oil systems targeting ISO 4406:99 cleanliness class 16/14/11. Pre- and post-flush oil sampling reports provided.
- **Laser Machine Alignment**: Shaft and coupling alignment using laser alignment equipment for turbine-gearbox-generator trains. Produces alignment reports with measured offsets and angularity.

## Products — 7 Categories, 70 Products

### Industrial Filtration (11 products)
OEM-compatible lube oil and control oil filter elements for Triveni (180 GPM), Siemens (850 LPM), and generic turbine systems. Also tank breather filters, hydraulic suction strainers, WaterSorp offline filter elements, PTFE air filters, return-line elements, duplex control oil assemblies, duplex fabricated filter housings, and RO filter assemblies.

### Expansion Joints (34 products)
Full range of metallic (SS 304/316/321, Inconel, Incoloy), rubber, and fabric expansion joints. Types include axial, universal, pressure-balanced, lateral, angular hinged, gimbal, elbow pressure-balanced, externally pressurised, steam crossover piping bellows, FCCU high-temperature joints, jacketed, clamshell retrofit, lens type, rectangular, district heating, cryogenic LNG/LPG, scrubber/exhaust, hygienic, T-type, dismantling joints, and MS/SS duct systems. Design codes: EJMA, ASME VIII Div.1, EN 14917.

### Industrial Strainers (5 products)
Simplex basket, duplex basket, conical (temporary), Y-type, and pot/bucket strainers. Available in SS 304/316 and carbon steel. Ratings from PN16 to PN100.

### Flexible Hoses & Assemblies (5 products)
SS corrugated flexible metal hose assemblies, SS pre-fitted assemblies, generator/engine exhaust bellows, PTFE-lined smooth bore hose assemblies, and high-pressure hydraulic rubber hose assemblies.

### Turbine Spares (11 products)
Carbon & graphite gland sealing rings, labyrinth shaft sealing packings, babbitt journal bearings and thrust pads, emergency stop valves (ESV), turbine lube oil pumps and mechanical seals, high-purity electrographite sealing rings, complete turbine rotor assemblies, precision turbine gears and worm wheels, turbine nozzles and diaphragms, mechanical centrifugal speed governors, and turbine throttle (control) valves.

### Industrial Rubber Products (2 products)
Custom extruded rubber profiles and seals, heavy-duty anti-vibration rubber mounts.

### Electronic Equipments (2 products)
Shinkawa non-contact eddy current vibration sensors (API 670 compliant), Woodward variable reluctance magnetic pickup sensors (MPU) for 505/505D/505E/2301/7206 governor systems.

- [Reverse Engineering Turbine Spares in India](https://keshaventerprises.in/#/blog/reverse-engineering-turbine-spares-india): Step-by-step process — 3D scanning, CMM, PMI testing, drawing generation, machining, and quality control.

## Industries Served

Power Generation (steam turbines 5–27 MW, thermal and captive power), Sugar Mills (Triveni and BHEL turbines for crushing season), Paper Mills (continuous-process turbines), Oil & Gas (refinery utility turbines, API 614 lube systems), Petrochemical (FCCU service, high-temperature expansion joints), Agro & Food Processing (food-grade components, FDA-compliant hoses), Cement (kiln and mill auxiliary systems).

## OEM Turbines Covered

Triveni, Siemens, BHEL, Belliss & Morcom, Maxwatt, Man Turbo, Chola Turbo, DLF-Skoda, KKK, ABB — both back-pressure and condensing types, single and multi-stage, horizontal and vertical configurations, 5 kW to 27 MW.
